faq.q: What is the average turnaround time for a website?
faq.a: Depending on complexity, a showcase site is delivered in 1 to 2 weeks, a corporate site in 3 to 4 weeks, and an e-commerce or custom platform in 4 to 8 weeks. We always respect agreed deadlines.

faq.q: Do you provide support after project delivery?
faq.a: Yes, every plan includes a warranty and support period ranging from 1 to 12 months. We also offer customized annual maintenance contracts.

faq.q: Are my data and my customers' data secure?
faq.a: Absolutely. We enforce industry best practices: SSL certificates, hardened hosting, automated backups, and protection against attacks.
We generally require a 50% deposit upon kickoff and the remaining balance upon delivery. We accept bank transfers, Mobile Money, and USD payments.

faq.q: Can I edit and update my website myself?
faq.a: Yes! For CMS-enabled projects, we train your team to use your intuitive control panel so you can update text, images, and pages independently.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside the DRC?
faq.a: Absolutely. We work with clients across the DRC, Burundi, Tanzania, Rwanda, and several other countries. All collaboration can be conducted remotely via WhatsApp, email, and video calls.
